calibration: k_ref is CALIBRATED to an external published measurement (carmustine's own wafer penetration profiles); it is not independently measured, and no carmustine tissue clearance constant has ever been measured directly. That is legitimate calibration and the opposite of what v4.1 did, which tuned a constant to widen our own result.
caveat: CAVEAT, carried in every report: in the only human study reporting per-patient cavity exposure, exposure did NOT predict the timing or the location of recurrence (1849 vs 2457 ng*day/mL, p = 0.393; local vs non-local 2666 vs 1608, p = 0.185; n = 15). It is small and underpowered, so this is 'not shown', not 'shown false'. But we score voxels by a quantity that has never been shown to predict a patient outcome, and that belongs in the limitations of anything we publish.
clinical_flag: The clinically delivered exposure is MEASURED in human resection-cavity FLUID by mass spectrometry (Ohnishi 2022, Brain Sci 12:567, n = 14-15): mean 262 umol*h/L, range 55-651. It is cavity fluid, not tissue, so it is an upper reference for what the approved therapy produces where the wafer sits, not a tissue target and not a bar.
kill_flag: The kill band is DERIVED BY FITTING a single clonogenic series in C6 rat glioma (two 1 h exposures; Caballero Navarro 1992, Histol Histopathol 7:347-351) with -log10(survival) = 0.0426 x exposure (half-kill near 7, one log of kill at 23.5 umol*h/L). Single study, one rat line, and not cleanly proportional at the top dose. It is a band, never a line.
old_gap_column_note: The old column 'gap larger than the band?' compared the oracle-minus-script gap with the +/-1-voxel band on the oracle's ABSOLUTE LEVEL. A paired difference does not inherit a level's uncertainty (the same mask shift moves both arms), so that column answered 'no' almost everywhere and contradicted the narrative drawn from the next column. It is replaced by: does the gap keep its sign and its order across the nominal, eroded and dilated masks?
potency: The clinically delivered exposure (262) is about ten times the one-log-kill level (23.5): potency is not the limitation; transport is.

sources.budget_mg: Gliadel label / NICE TA121: at most 8 wafers x 7.7 mg BCNU = 61.6 mg, the clinical maximum (grounding report, delivery ledger). A per-case cap, never scaled by perceived volume and never tuned.
sources.d_star_cm2_s: Free TMA+ diffusivity 1.311e-5 cm2/s at 37 C (Vorisek & Sykova 1997, J Neurophysiol 78:912) divided by gray-matter tortuosity^2 with lambda ~ 1.55-1.60 (Hrabetova et al. 2018, J Neurosci 38:9355) gives D* ~ 5.1e-6 cm2/s. DECLARED SUBSTITUTION: no measured BCNU effective diffusivity in brain exists; the small-molecule TMA value stands in.
sources.k_clear_s: Bork et al. 2024, PNAS 121(16):e2318444121: the Groothuis replication of the efflux constant, about 5x faster, = 6.0e-4 /s, a difference the authors attribute to anaesthetic choice. HIGH end of a genuine 5x literature conflict; not rounding, so both ends are carried and every result is reported for both.
sources.molar_mass_g_mol: Carmustine C5H9Cl2N3O2, 214.05 g/mol (standard molecular formula and atomic masses; NOT from the grounding report). Only used to convert mg to umol.
sources.tick_seconds: Declared in config (v4.31 goal, Step A): a derived quantity, never implicit. Default 1800 s (30 min). The grounding report shows the tick is a trade-off, not a measurement: spread-per-tick and loss-per-tick cannot both be ~1 voxel / small.
sources.ticks: v4.1 world.yaml episode length (120 ticks); 60 h at the default 1800 s tick (v4.31 goal, Step A).
sources.voxel_mm: Perception store grid: store_adapter requires a 2.0 mm crop grid (v4.31 goal, Step A: 'from the perception store').
